subject.title: Feature: Default outbound topic/thread binding per agent for Telegram

question: Should Telegram topic config gain an opt-in per-agent outbound default, or should proactive sends continue relying only on explicit `threadId` and current-source topic inheritance?
rationale: This adds a new config/default surface and visible delivery precedence for successful sends, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and not safe for an automatic fix lane.

options.title: Approve narrow outbound default
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned opt-in default with explicit precedence below per-call `threadId` and current-source topic inheritance, then validate fresh and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep explicit/current-context only
options.body: Do not add config surface; document that proactive sends must pass `threadId` or run with source context that can auto-inherit the topic.

options.title: Defer to broader delivery design
options.body: Keep this issue open until outbound delivery defaults are designed across threaded channels rather than Telegram alone.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow outbound default
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned opt-in default with explicit precedence below per-call `threadId` and current-source topic inheritance, then validate fresh and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue needs config/product-direction judgment and `steipete` appears in recent Telegram topic/config-adjacent history and the issue timeline mentions.
